_comment: Small built-in offline advisory set for demonstration. It is intentionally tiny; for real use, pair this tool with osv-scanner or pip-audit and feed their JSON output through the importer.

requests.summary: Requests before 2.20.0 sends the HTTP Authorization header to an https URI upon an http-to-https redirect.

urllib3.summary: urllib3 before 1.26.5 allows catastrophic backtracking (ReDoS) via crafted URLs when an attacker controls the URL.

flask.summary: Flask before 1.0 has a JSON denial-of-service issue (unbounded resource use decoding crafted JSON).
flask.fix: Upgrade Flask to >= 1.0 (prefer a currently supported release).

django.summary: Django QuerySet.annotate/aggregate/extra SQL injection via crafted column aliases (**kwargs) in affected 2.2/3.2/4.0 lines.
django.fix: Upgrade to a patched Django release (2.2.28+, 3.2.13+, 4.0.4+).

pyyaml.summary: PyYAML before 5.4: full_load / yaml.load with FullLoader can execute arbitrary code on untrusted input.
pyyaml.fix: Upgrade PyYAML to >= 5.4 and prefer yaml.safe_load.

lodash.summary: lodash before 4.17.12 is vulnerable to prototype pollution via defaultsDeep.

minimist.summary: minimist before 1.2.6 allows prototype pollution via crafted arguments.
minimist.fix: Upgrade minimist to >= 1.2.6 (or 0.2.4 for the 0.x line).

axios.summary: axios before 0.21.1 is vulnerable to SSRF via redirects that bypass proxy restrictions.
